title: Data API query refusal: a where of the wrong type answers three identical bare "Invalid input" entries and no cause
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CajiB6BSQKWowy6YLB

Adjacent finding from the #35433 decision analysis (project file `objectstack-seat5/area-ux/data-2/decision-35433.md`, readings at `main` `f6902e950`, scratch probe). Filed on seat 5's word. Parent: #35433.

## What the caller sees
A data-API query whose `where` has the wrong type (`query.where: 42`) is refused with three identical entries in `fields[]`, each `{ field: 'query.where', code: 'invalid_shape', message: 'Invalid input' }`, and nothing else. No entry names the cause (that `where` must be a filter object or a filter AST array). Under #35433's recommended rule (drop a bare head only when a later entry explains it) two of the three would remain, because nothing explains them. The repeat is its own defect, not #35433's.

A nearby case from the same probe: `query.where: [['status','=','open'],'and']` gives five entries, four of them `Invalid input`.

## Where
- Producer: `packages/spec/src/api/zod-issues-to-fields.ts` (`zodIssuesToFields`, the union head push ~:214), which runs once per nested union layer of the `where` schema.
- Door: the data API query route (`packages/rest/src/crud-routes.ts` / `batch-routes.ts` callers listed in the analysis).

## Done when
A `where` of the wrong type is refused with one entry that names the accepted shapes (filter object or AST array), with no duplicate `Invalid input` entries. Pins cover `42`, a string and a malformed AST, and a CONTROL shows a valid `where` is still served. Because this removes entries from a published response, it is declared `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` or `no (narrowing)` as the diff shows, with BREAKING, an ADR-0087 marker, dogfood and a contract-tier review. Build it after #35433's ruling, since it touches the same producer.

## Grade
p2 · area:data · domain:server. The query door's main caller is an AI agent writing through the data API. A refused query with no stated cause leaves the agent guessing and retrying.
